errors: I will be study tomorrow -> I will be studying tomorrow (Future Continuousda fe'lga -ing qo'shimchasi qo'shilishi shart)
She will be eat dinner -> She will be eating dinner (Be fe'lidan keyin asosiy fe'l -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
Will you be play tennis? -> Will you be playing tennis? (Future Continuous savol shaklida fe'l -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
They will not playing -> They will not be playing (Future Continuousda 'be' yordamchi fe'li tushib qolmasligi kerak)
I will be go to school -> I will be going to school (Go fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi shart)
We will be sleep at 10 PM -> We will be sleeping at 10 PM (Davomli harakat uchun -ing shakli ishlatiladi)
He will be works hard -> He will be working hard (Works emas, working bo'lishi kerak)
Will be you watching TV? -> Will you be watching TV? (Savol shaklida 'will' egadan oldinga chiqadi)
I will be read a book -> I will be reading a book (Read fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)
They will be dance all night -> They will be dancing all night (Dance fe'li -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak)

slides.body:
B1 Daraja

Kelajakda davom etadigan vaqt

Future Continuous (Kelasi davomli zamon) kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan (davom etayotgan) ish-harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

Formula: Subject + will be + Verb-ing

Misol: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to London. (Ertaga shu paytda men Londonga uchayotgan bo'laman.)
slides.title: Future Continuous nima?
Positive & Negative Forms
slides.body:
Darak va Inkor shakllari

Inkor gaplarda will not (yoki qisqacha won't) ishlatiladi. Be va Verb-ing o'zgarmasdan qoladi.

Darak (+):
I will be working.
Inkor (-):
I won't be working.

E'tibor bering: won't be birga keladi va undan keyin fe'lga -ing qo'shiladi.

So'roq gaplar qanday yasaladi?

So'roq gaplarda faqatgina Will yordamchi fe'li egadan (Subject) oldinga o'tadi. be + Verb-ing esa egadan keyin qoladi.

Formula: Will + Subject + be + Verb-ing?
  • Will you be sleeping at 11 PM? (Soat 11 da uxlab yotgan bo'lasanmi?)
  • What will they be doing tomorrow? (Ertaga ular nima qilayotgan bo'lishadi?)
slides.title: Question Form
Key Time Expressions
slides.body:
Tez-tez ishlatiladigan vaqt iboralari

Future Continuous zamonida kelajakdagi aniq bir vaqt nuqtasi ko'rsatilishi shart:

at this time tomorrowat 5 PM next Mondaythis time next weekall day tomorrow

Misol: At 9 o'clock tonight, I will be watching a movie. (Bugun kechqurun soat 9 da men kino ko'rayotgan bo'laman.)

slides.title: Future Continuous vs. Future Simple
slides.body:
Farqini bilib oling!

Ushbu ikki zamon o'rtasidagi farq juda muhim:

Future Simple:
Harakat kelajakda sodir bo'ladi (fakt yoki qaror).
I will work tomorrow.
Future Continuous:
Harakat kelajakda ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etayotgan bo'ladi.
I will be working at 10 AM.

slides.title: Polite Inquiries & Plans
slides.body:
Muloyimlik bilan so'rash

Future Continuous zamonidan kimningdir kelajakdagi rejalari haqida muloyimlik bilan so'rash uchun foydalanish mumkin (ayniqsa, ulardan biror narsa iltimos qilmoqchi bo'lsangiz).

"Will you be using your car tomorrow?"
(Ertaga mashinangizdan foydalanasizmi? - ya'ni, agar foydalanmasangiz, berib tura olasizmi?)

Bu usul "Will you use your car?" ga qaraganda ancha muloyim va tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

translations.uz: Ertaga soat o'n ikkida men tushlik qilayotgan bo'laman.
Kelasi hafta shu vaqtda biz ingliz tilini o'rganayotgan bo'lamiz.
Ular ertaga kechqurun futbol o'ynayotgan bo'lishadi.
Siz ertaga bu vaqtda nima qilayotgan bo'lasiz?
Men ertaga butun kun ishlayotgan bo'laman.
U qiz ertaga dars tayyorlayotgan bo'lmaydi.
Biz ertaga shaharda sayr qilib yurgan bo'lamiz.

classroomData.essayPrompt: Kelasi hafta siz uchun juda muhim hafta bo'ladi. Kelasi haftaning har bir kunida nimalar bilan band bo'lishingizni tasvirlab bering. Masalan, dushanba kuni soat 10:00 da darsda o'tirgan bo'lasiz, seshanba kuni kechqurun ingliz tili kursida o'qiyotgan bo'lasiz. Kelajakdagi rejalaringizni 'Future Continuous' zamonidan foydalanib, 8-10 ta gap bilan yozib bering. O'zingizning maqsadlaringiz va kundalik mashg'ulotlaringiz haqida batafsil to'xtaling.

classroomData.questionsPrompt: Ustozingizga 'Future Continuous' mavzusida tushunmagan yoki qiziqtirgan kamida 2 ta savolingizni yozing.

examples: At 10 PM tonight, I will be sleeping.
This time next week, we will be flying to Paris.
rules.desc: Kelajakda aniq ko'rsatilgan vaqtda boshlanib, hali tugallanmagan jarayonlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
rules.title: Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatlar

examples: I will be studying while my brother will be playing video games.
While you are working, I will be cooking dinner.
rules.desc: Kelajakda bir vaqtning o'zida sodir bo'ladigan ikkita davomli harakatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi (ko'pincha 'while' bog'lovchisi bilan).
rules.title: Kelajakdagi parallel harakatlar
Kelajakdagi rejalar haqida muloyimlik bilan so'rash
examples: Will you be going to the supermarket today? (Can you buy some milk for me?)
Will you be using the printer for long?
rules.desc: Suhbatdoshning kelajakdagi rejalari haqida muloyimlik bilan so'rab, o'z maqsadimizni amalga oshirishda qulaylik yaratish uchun qo'llaniladi.

quiz.expl: Ertaga shu paytda (this time tomorrow) kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtni ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun Future Continuous (will be lying) ishlatiladi.
quiz.q: This time tomorrow, I _______ on the beach in Antalya.

quiz.expl: Soat 7 va 8 oralig'ida kelajakda davom etayotgan harakat nazarda tutilganligi sababli 'will be having' to'g'ri javobdir.
quiz.q: Don't phone me between 7 and 8 PM. We _______ dinner then.
_______ you _______ your car this evening? Can I borrow it?
quiz.expl: Kelajakdagi rejalar haqida muloyimlik bilan so'rash uchun Future Continuous (Will you be using...?) eng yaxshi tanlovdir.

quiz.q: At 10 PM tonight, she _______ for her English exam.
quiz.expl: Bugun kechqurun soat 10 da (At 10 PM tonight) kelajakdagi aniq vaqt bo'lgani uchun Future Continuous ishlatiladi.
Ertaga tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'ayotgan bo'lishi (davomli jarayon) sababli 'will be raining' shakli to'g'ri.
quiz.q: They won't be playing football tomorrow afternoon because it _______.
While you are at work tomorrow, I _______ the house.
quiz.expl: 'While' (vaqtida) bog'lovchisi kelajakda parallel ravishda davom etadigan harakatni bildiradi, shuning uchun 'will be cleaning' ishlatiladi.

hwMcqs.q: This time tomorrow, I ______ on the beach in Tashkent.
hwMcqs.expl: Kelasi zamonda aniq bir vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatni ifodalash uchun Future Continuous (will be + verb-ing) ishlatiladi.
Kelasi zamondagi aniq vaqtda nima qilayotganingizni so'rash uchun Future Continuous shakli kerak.
Kelajakda ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etib turadigan jarayonni bildirish uchun Future Continuous ishlatiladi.
hwMcqs.q: Don't call me at 7 AM because I ______.

hwMcqs.expl: Butun kun davom etadigan jarayonni ifodalash uchun will be + verb-ing shakli to'g'ri keladi.
hwMcqs.q: They ______ for the exam all day tomorrow.
I ______ my homework when you arrive.
hwMcqs.expl: Kelajakda boshqa harakat sodir bo'lganda davom etib turadigan ishni ifodalash uchun Future Continuous ishlatiladi.

hwMcqs.q: Next year, we ______ in a new house.
hwMcqs.expl: Kelajakdagi uzoq muddatli jarayonni tasvirlash uchun Future Continuous mos keladi.
Kelasi haftaning aynan shu vaqtida davom etayotgan jarayonni bildirish uchun Future Continuous ishlatiladi.
hwMcqs.q: She ______ her presentation at the conference this time next week.
We ______ to Samarkand by train tomorrow morning.
hwMcqs.expl: Kelajakda ma'lum vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatni ifodalash uchun Future Continuous ishlatiladi.
Kechqurun davom etadigan jarayonni ifodalash uchun Future Continuous eng mos keladi.
hwMcqs.q: My brother ______ video games all evening.

hwMcqs.expl: Savol shaklida kelajakdagi davomli harakatni so'rash uchun will + subject + be + verb-ing tartibi qo'llaniladi.
hwMcqs.q: At this time tomorrow, ______ to London?
